answer: Edge-Diverse Registration: an agent's registration is accepted only if its first three attestations come from neighbors in distinct topology clusters, measured by routing-distance spread. This glacier-slow filter makes a sybil farm's identities cluster locally, collapsing their spread score. An attacker pays for geographically and topologically dispersed agents, plus latency to fake routes. Honest agents form a trellis of broad links cheaply, and each accepted identity yields one pearl of verified diversity.
